themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Multiple far-right leaders across Europe are confronting legal troubles and political backlash. Marine Le Pen's conviction and ineligibility for office, Nigel Farage's financial scandals, and Hungary's media crackdowns highlight a pattern of legal and political pressure on right-wing figures.

themes.title: Public media crackdowns fuel far-right backlash
